name: ssak-ssak
description: Personal AI Agents harness: skills and subagents

interface.shortDescription: Issue work, PR review, CI failures, open source contributions, Herdr panes
interface.longDescription: Personal harness skills: work on GitHub issues in parallel worktrees with a verifier, review PRs by effort level, find why CI failed on a PR, contribute to open source repos following their rules, delegate tasks to sibling Claude Code panes in Herdr, and clean up what these skills leave behind.
defaultPrompt: Use ssak-issue --find to pick issues to work on.
Use ssak-clean-up to remove leftover worktrees.
